tagline: An analyst agent that answers why-questions about company performance with evidence-backed, critic-verified claims.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

zetaris.role: Data layer: every query the agent runs goes through Zetaris Lightning SQL over REST (POST /sql-editor/sqls/run), across federated REST sources (SEC EDGAR XBRL, company_dns SIC, World Bank) and the sic_edgar_usl Unified Semantic Layer.

meterless.nightshift: Primary AI provider: OpenAI-compatible Meterless Runtime (Bearer token, meterless-app/meterless-scope headers, /v1/models discovery); the model that handled each call is recorded and shown.

engines.h-mem: Persistent memory of verified findings with provenance (derivedFrom evidence + Zetaris query ids), recall before investigating, trust-ledger audit, feedback.
engines.world-model: Grounds companies to real CIK/ticker/SIC before investigating; unknown names are refused instead of invented; metric observations keep provenance.
engines.markovian: Bounded carried context per reasoning step inside each hypothesis loop (flat cost per step), with bounded-vs-naive token figures shown in the UI.
engines.scout-intent: Intent detection, risk check (blocks write/DDL/exfiltration), tool routing and an HMAC-signed execution contract whose tools and budgets are enforced in code.

nvidia.role: NVIDIA Nemotron models, served through Meterless Nightshift, act as planner, SQL investigator and critic; the handling model id is recorded for every call.

cursor.role: Not used; the project was built with Claude Code (Cursor is optional per the 22 Oct organiser update).
